type_cycle_reason: Files on import cycles made only of type imports, which TypeScript erases, so nothing loads in a loop: the commands/config, types and vfs/base tangle, and four pairs that borrow types from each other (lancedb accessor and query, qdrant accessor and query, the pyodide worker and runtime, the dispatcher and namespace). Python has the same pairs, so breaking one moves types in both languages to keep symbol parity. The count may not move in either direction: a new type cycle fails, and a broken one has to lower it.
